runtime: Ubuntu 22.04 (Linux 5.15), Python 3.10, cryptography 44.0.3, Microsoft Graph beta (2026-10-28); targets: 2 Windows 11 devices, Entra joined, Intune managed
procedure: deploy_win32_app.py Intune/Win32Apps/CloudflareOneClient/app.json --group-id <one-user group> --param ORGANIZATION=<team> --installer-file <MSI verified against the manifest SHA-256>, with a delegated token (DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All, Global Administrator activated through PIM). Install state read afterwards with reports/retrieveDeviceAppInstallationStatusReport (app-only read).
expected: win32LobApp created, content committed, publishingState published, required assignment to the group, and both devices report InstallState installed without errors.
